name: map_piSingleton
statement: (n : ℕ) → Measure (X n)) [∀ n, SigmaFinite (μ n)] (n : ℕ) : (μ (n + 1)).map (piSingleton n) = Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc n (n + 1) ↦ μ i)
